about: Player-path access guard rules (plan Spielerweg P0 / gate G2). Read by tools/player_guard.py (audit hook in every Python tool process) and by TruCommon.psm1 Test-TruPlayerPath (tool arguments of Invoke-TruPipeline). Paths are matched in lower case with forward slashes, after resolving junctions; 'ws' = relative to the workspace (the folder that holds the repository), 'repo' = relative to the repository, 'name' = regular expression on the file name alone. A prefix ending in '/' matches the folder itself and everything below it. action refuse = refused when TRU_PLAYER_MODE=enforce (logged as would-refuse in report mode); action log = only logged (the player may have it, the plan has not decided yet).

xbox_base.why: Xbox 360 base game (layer1 / layer2, default.xex, the title update's exe patch, movies, system update): developers only; a player never has or needs it
name: ^layer[12]\.\d{3}$
^default\.xexp?$

xbox_derived.why: developer intermediate data that holds Xbox base-game bytes or their section index (plan section 3); store.pkl is refused as a whole because its xb_store part is base-game bytes (a player store without xb_store is plan step P2 / P8)
name: ^tu_image_[0-9a-f]+\.bin$
^retail_image_[0-9a-f]+\.bin$

yura.why: Yura 1.7.2 file lists (third-party names only): the plan keeps them as a download or moves the needed names into the knowledge package (open)

kit.why: community kits / kit-derived trees (B90 / B132 / B138 / B269 / B270, pristine snapshots): not on the player path either (plan section 1); logged only in P0

allow.why: the player's own Xbox title update (player input; md5 of the whole file, checked once per process; another file is refused). d49ae004... is the raw md5 of its generalbank record (docs/data/generalbank_pc.json tu.raw_md5), checked by generalbank_pc_build
